<quote by="Announced by Borys Vardovich Strascovich, Boyar of the Iron Roads">Borys Vardovich Strascovich, Boyar of the Iron Roads, announces the building of the Shchaslyvyy Outpost Sappery a (12 mithril) mana ministry in Varushka to be assigned by Tally of the Votes. </quote>
==Overview==
* Creates a ministry in [[Ossium]] that allows the purchase of mana crystals
* Announcement by the [[Boyar of the Iron Roads]]
==Date==
* Spring 386YE
==Cost==
* Standard costs apply
* 12 mithril
* 36 crowns
* Three months to complete
==Progress==
{{CommissionProgress|Shchaslyvyy_Outpost_Sappery}}
==Outcome==
* Now complete, the [[Custodian of the Shchaslyvyy Spile]] will be appointed by Tally of the Votes of the Varushkan mine and forest owners for the first time at the Summer Solstice 386YE.
